text.tspan: 1. Contacts close to J7-3 (COM). Closed = opto LED on (~3.8 mA wetting current) = GPIO reads LOW.
2. Door contact: reed switch, closed when the door is shut. Exit button: normally-open push button.
3. Tamper: micro-switch pressed by the closed lid (closed = LOW). Lid opened or wire cut = HIGH = tamper event.
4. J7-3 is board ground, which is NOT isolated from J1. Do not connect J7-3 to the lock power supply.
